dedupeText: gritty monochrome country portrait monochrome high contrast cowboy hat distressed typography film grain low key lighting subject s face partially obscured by hat brim and shadow typography centered horizontally in the lower third texture of the distressed font mirroring the film grain of the photo high contrast between the bright background and the dark silhouette of the hat combine a low key monochromatic portrait with a heavily distressed beveled slab serif typographic overlay to create a rugged masculine aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, grainy black and white portrait featuring a central subject in a cowboy hat with integrated distressed display typography.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist vector styles are requested
soft focus or high-key lighting is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, low-key monochrome photograph of a man in a cowboy hat, characterized by heavy film grain and deep shadows, featuring a large, weathered typographic element that overlaps the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face partially obscured by hat brim and shadow
Typography centered horizontally in the lower third
Texture of the distressed font mirroring the film grain of the photo
High contrast between the bright background and the dark silhouette of the hat
coreInvariants: Heavy monochromatic film grain texture across all elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait, subject occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame, slightly off-center to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, distressed 'X' character centered in the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes under the hat brim, down the line of the face to the central typographic logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-contrast white space on the left side balancing the dark mass of the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays in the subject and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the background highlights and typographic highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays providing texture and grain.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed slab serif and heavy block serif
letterConstructionRules: Tall, condensed proportions for secondary text
Heavy, oversized central character with slab serifs
Visible weathering, chipping, and stone-like texture applied to all glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Central 'X' is scaled significantly larger to act as a divider and anchor
Bottom metadata text is ultra-bold and wide to provide a stable base
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A tall condensed display face paired with an oversized central iconographic letter and a wide, heavy block base.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed weight and impact.
Matches the slab serif requirements for the central character.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black and white close-up portrait of a man in a cowboy hat, looking down, with deep shadows and a bright white background on one side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, centered, distressed slab-serif typographic logo in the lower third, featuring a textured stone effect and heavy beveling.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain prominent across both the photo and the text?
Does the central 'X' or large character anchor the composition?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep blacks?

postGenerationChecks: Verify typographic texture matches background grain
Ensure the hat brim creates a strong shadow over the eyes
Confirm the slab serifs are blocky and weathered
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key monochromatic portrait with a heavily distressed, beveled slab-serif typographic overlay to create a rugged, masculine aesthetic.
